reasoning_traces.think:
The three primitives form a triadic system: the Contest Fill Rate Panel encodes probabilistic outcomes of user decisions, Live Picks Grid State represents deterministic configurations of picks, and User Engagement Signal provides temporal dynamics. These interact through a feedback loop where engagement drives grid updates, which in turn influence panel states. The system exhibits dual behavior—stochastic (fill rate) and deterministic (grid), enabling robust inference under uncertainty. Failure modes include signal degradation when idle time exceeds thresholds, or grid overload during peak engagement. The mathematical structure supports recursive Bayesian updating and state-space transitions.
